descriptions.text: Valtay Perso-Shield Platinum Edition. – Tech-based Personal Shield.

recap.text: Waiting out the timer, Carl sorts a new History tab by value and finds a Valtay tunnel communications relay, a Valtay Corp pulse pistol, and a Valtay Perso-Shield Platinum Edition, a tech-based personal shield. A blue dot approaches, and Carl understands he took Agatha's whole shopping cart into his inventory during the fight with the Ball of Swine and never examined it. She wheels the squeaking cart in and calls him a cart thief.

Carl uses two of his three Cracker Jack scrolls to unlock a Valtay Perso-Shield, Platinum Edition, a round pinback button that looks a little like Saturn. When a succubus slams into him and goes for his neck, he switches it on, and her fangs spark and shatter like broken crockery. The shield sparks out under her grip, and a tentacle from Donut's stolen Hell Scrub drags her away.

beats.headline: In the History tab
beats.text: Waiting out the timer, Carl opens a new inventory tab labelled History and sorts it by value. At the top sit three items he has never seen: a Valtay tunnel communications relay, a Valtay Corp pulse pistol, and a Valtay Perso-Shield Platinum Edition, a tech-based personal shield. The relay carries a warning that unsanctioned communication devices are illegal down here. Then a blue dot moves toward them, and when Carl sees who it is, he understands: he took Agatha's whole shopping cart into his inventory during the boss fight with the Ball of Swine and never examined it. She wheels the squeaking cart in and calls him a cart thief.
beats.gist: Carl finds Agatha's shopping cart, taken during the Ball of Swine fight, holds a Valtay Perso-Shield Platinum Edition.

beats.headline: A Saturn on his shirt
beats.text: Back from the homeless shelter, Carl uses two of the three Cracker Jack scrolls from his trade to unlock a pair of alien shields out of the hunters' tech loot. His is a Valtay Perso-Shield, Platinum Edition, identical to the one he would have had from Paulie: a round pinback button that looks a little like Saturn, needing no equipment slot, switched on and off from his interface. It stops physical damage and somewhat stops corporeal spells like Magic Missile and Fireball. It lasts about two minutes and recharges in about an hour, and it covers Donut on his shoulder only if she is touching him when it comes on.
beats.gist: Carl unlocks a Valtay Perso-Shield, a Saturn-like pinback button that blocks physical damage for two minutes per hour.

beats.headline: Teeth on the buffer
beats.text: A succubus picks Carl out across the hallway, I choose you, stud, shrugs off a banger sphere and slams into him with the force of a bus. As she goes for his neck with vampire fangs, he activates his new tech-based shield, and her teeth spark and shatter like broken crockery. He casts Wisp Armor to shore it up. Her hands sparkle where they grip his arms, and the shield loses power fast as she slams him against the floor. It sparks out just as a tentacle from Donut's stolen Hell Scrub drags her away.
beats.gist: Carl's Perso-Shield shatters a succubus's fangs, then sparks out until Donut's Hell Scrub drags her off.
